description: Provider-free live package skeleton for FinRobot coding.py notebook, image display, and generated-code tooling contracts.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by this skeleton; live notebook kernels, file systems, and execution sandboxes must be supplied by future external packages behind capability gates.

cleanup_policy.reason: Provider-free replay records cleanup intent without touching the host filesystem.

test_gates: manifest and referenced JSON files decode without external dependencies
provider_free is true and live_network_default is false
sandbox command execution, file writes, and notebook kernels deny by default unless an approval fixture grants the exact capability
file and image artifact contracts require artifact_id, path, media_type, sha256, bytes, provenance, and replay_key
denied command fixture captures command, reason, stdout, stderr, exit_code, and approval decision
denied command envelopes record cwd, argv, env allowlist, shell disabled, timeout bucket, and executed=false
stdout and stderr captures are explicit channel records and are compared during replay
file artifact manifest separates generated file outputs from image display outputs
image artifact manifest pins dimensions, notebook cell id, media type, and artifact hash
deterministic replay fixture pins stdout, stderr, duration bucket, artifact hashes, and display-image metadata
cleanup policy is fixture_noop, preserves checked-in fixture metadata, and records host paths that would be cleaned by a real package
capability metadata declares file, command, stdout, stderr, image display, artifact publish, and replay boundaries

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide FinRobot coding.py execution, notebook kernels, image display, or sandboxed command runners as built-ins; future external packages must satisfy these contracts and approval gates.
